title: Gotthard Tunnel proof of concept scan

tellings.quote: this is the final proof of concept, the Gotthard Tunnel.

plain: In 2024 a scan of the Gotthard Tunnel in Switzerland served as 'the final proof of concept' for a method of seeing deep underground, according to the researcher Jeffrey Drum, who ties the work to a man named Filippo Biondi. Drum tells Michels this without naming a source, in an episode about what he calls a huge energy grid under the pyramids of Egypt. The point is that if the method worked on a known tunnel, it can be trusted on what it shows beneath the pyramids.
